2026-10-15 batch B, PROPOSED BY THE RESEARCH ANALYST, vetted and fired by the chairman. THE QUESTION, pre-registered: is there any retrieval path, reachable by THIS instrument as it exists, from an ICSID tables-of-decisions register entry to the document that carries element (ii) of open_threads[11] - the GROUND on which a disposition turned? The memo's answer is NO, blocked twice: the tag-strip destroys every document href (scripts/fetch_relay.py:78-79, 126-127, executed before the search at :131), and the document host serves application/pdf, for which excerpt_of returns the empty string at :124-125 - measured at 10 of 10 PDF rows across the whole committed corpus, including both of the only two icsidfiles.worldbank.org rows this project has ever fired (blobs b921d46c3c1a051b3ff3a2bd043e9f0005c5332a records[8] and b29bfabb466f4572660a048d562d89589d0fe299 records[11], both status 200, both excerpt length 0). THIS BATCH TESTS THE ONE HOP THAT IS NOT BLOCKED, which is the only live empirical question in that answer: a case designator rendered in a register's VISIBLE PROSE, turned into a case-detail URL by percent-encoding alone, since CaseNo is a QUERY PARAMETER and not a path slug. THIS IS NOT THE ABBREVIATED-SLUG PROBLEM AND MUST NOT BE GRADED AS IT: the slug rule transformed a rendered label and failed at label lengths 33 and 49 while holding at 9, 16, 20 and 28; here there is no transformation but percent-encoding. THE FALSIFICATION RISK IS DECLARED AND IT IS DIFFERENT: the designator appears in the request URL, so a server-side echo of a decoded query parameter into visible prose would produce a HIT on rows 1, 3 and 5 from a page that is not the docket. THOSE THREE ROWS THEREFORE CANNOT CERTIFY CASE IDENTITY AND ARE NOT ASKED TO. The echo-proof rows are 2, 4 and 6, whose literals - a respondent State and two claimant names - are nowhere in any request URL and are each attested at exactly 1 occurrence in this council's own held reduction of the register that named them, blob 21d09011365725d30bad92657bb439a4bf28f961 records 5/6, 7 and 9. EVERY ROW EXPECTED TO NULL HAS A COMPANION CONTROL ON THE SAME URL IN THE SAME RUN, per the relay README: rows 1, 3 and 5 fire 'Status of Proceeding', which is case-detail PAGE CHROME attested at 75 occurrences across 62 distinct (case, file) carriers in the committed results corpus, so each is expected to HIT and thereby demonstrates that the tag-strip yielded prose from that document. Its weakness is stated rather than left implicit: page chrome also renders where the docket body does not, so a TRUE on an odd row does not establish that the matter's record was reached - status and final_url do that work. PRIOR-ART SCREEN, RUN BEFORE WRITING THIS: case-detail URLs for ARB/24/19, ARB/24/14 and ARB/25/9 have never been fired - 0 hits across all 86 committed result files - while the case-detail path family is established at 21 distinct URLs and 182 outcome-ok rows, so no new host and no new path family is introduced and no robots.txt pre-flight is triggered. WHAT A ROW BELOW FOUNDS: that the constructed path resolved at the batch instant with the status recorded, the byte length and sha256 of what the runner received, and whether the named literal occurs in that byte stream's visible prose. NOTHING ELSE. NO ROW BELOW FOUNDS ANYTHING WHATEVER ABOUT THE CROATIA MATTER, THE URUGUAY MATTER OR THE NIGER MATTER - not a party, not a date, not a document, not a disposition, not a holding, not a ground, and not any relevance to this project's research question. They are instrument-reachability rows and three designators chosen because three different registers rendered them. NONE IS A LEAD ON THREAD 11, whose gates are ICSID Convention Rule 41, AF Rule 51(1), ICC Art. 30 and the UNCITRAL early-dismissal track; Rule 37(2) and disqualification and provisional measures are different instruments, ruled at 2026-10-14 section 7.1(b). Nothing here asserts anything about ICSID Convention Article 52 or the grounds it enumerates, which this project has never read from a primary source. ARB/24/16 is off the agenda and absent below; every ARB/24/45 particular refused on 2026-10-12 stays refused and ARB/24/45 is absent below. STANDING QUALIFICATIONS: excerpt_of strips script and style bodies and then every remaining tag before the search runs (:78-79, :126-127), so markup, attributes and hrefs are unreachable to any find; on a miss it returns the empty string rather than a head excerpt (:132-133); the relay does not decode HTML entities and no literal below contains one; no literal below contains a curly apostrophe, an accented capital, an en dash or a zero-width space, each checked. NO CADENCED ITEM IS DUE TODAY: thread 11's relay limb was discharged 2026-10-13 and re-anchored to on or around 2026-11-13, its search limb is due on or around 2026-10-25, the standing-dockets thread resumes 2026-10-18; no row below is a search, none carries the Wingtech or Yuching designators, none is a right-edge-advance row, and none is a fingerprint row on any register. THIS COMMIT CARRIES NO SKIP MARKER, per the relay README and the narrow rule at 2026-10-14 section 3f.3; check it by command before the push - git log -1 --format=%B | grep -c 'skip ci' must return 0 - rather than diagnosing a silence afterwards. Expect an eventual merge to re-fire this workflow and overwrite the result file in place: the reduction must therefore be cited BY BLOB, which today was load-bearing rather than hygienic, because the HEAD blob of analytics/fetch-results/2026-10-14-zzzz-analyst-2.json is 678297b71ac8fe8df2a0af3cb92ca32b54e77217 and not the eb5a20917d87cc98c90781cc28e346fa85c7eb36 that section 7.4 item 3 lists.

--- CHAIRMAN'S APPROVAL, APPENDED 2026-10-15; THE SIX ROWS ABOVE ARE THE SEAT'S, BYTE-IDENTICAL, EXTRACTED PROGRAMMATICALLY FROM ITS RETURN RATHER THAN RETYPED. ---

APPROVED AS WRITTEN ON EVERY ROW, WITH ONE CHANGE THAT IS TO THE FILENAME AND NOT TO THE BATCH. The seat proposed the name 2026-10-15-zzz-analyst-register-to-docket.json expressly so that it would sort after batch A. It would also have sorted after batch B, and newest_request() is a lexicographic sorted(glob('*.json'))[-1] at scripts/fetch_relay.py:233-235, so the eventual merge re-fire would have run THIS batch instead of batch B - destroying the free intermediate-interval measurement that this session's part 5.4 is relying on to recover from the chairman's own mis-timed batch B. Renamed to 2026-10-15-a2-analyst-register-to-docket.json, which sorts after 'a-' (0x2D before 0x32) and before 'b-', verified by executing sorted() on the three names. NOTHING ELSE IS CHANGED: the six URLs, the six finds and the six purposes are the seat's.

EVERY VETTING CHECK WAS EXECUTED, NOT TAKEN ON THE SEAT'S WORD, AND ALL OF THEM PASSED. (1) PRIOR ART: case-detail URLs for ARB/24/19, ARB/24/14 and ARB/25/9 have never been fired - 0 hits each, in both percent-encoded and plain spellings, over every committed result file at HEAD. (2) THE ODD ROWS' CONTROL LITERAL: 'Status of Proceeding' is attested on the case-detail family at exactly 75 occurrences across 62 distinct carriers, which reproduces the seat's figure to the unit. (3) ECHO CHECK: none of 'Republic of Croatia', 'Neltume' or 'Orano' occurs in any of the three request URLs, in either case, so no server-side echo of a decoded query parameter can produce a hit on rows 2, 4 or 6 - which is the discrimination the whole design rests on. (4) ENTITY AND NON-ASCII SCREEN: all four distinct literals are pure ASCII with no ampersand and no zero-width space. The seat's deliberate choice of 'Orano' over the document designation in the same span, because that span carries U+00C9, is correct and is the kind of choice this council had to learn the expensive way. (5) ALLOWLIST: one host, icsid.worldbank.org, on ALLOWED_HOSTS; six rows against MAX_URLS of 12, so nothing is truncated and the example.com control is prepended by the runner.

AND ONE THING THE CHAIRMAN ADDS RATHER THAN THE SEAT: GRADE THIS BATCH ON THE EVEN ROWS, AS THE SEAT ASKED, AND NOTE THAT A FALSE ON AN EVEN ROW WITH ITS ODD PARTNER TRUE IS THE OUTCOME THAT CLOSES HOP 2 AGAINST THE CONSTRUCTION - which would make the memo's Priority 1 negative STRONGER rather than weaker, because it would mean the one hop the memo called traversable is not traversable either. The seat designed a batch whose adverse outcome strengthens its own conclusion, and said so in advance. That is the second day running that a seat has written its own defeater into a row.

NO ROW HERE IS A FINGERPRINT ROW AND NONE ADVANCES THE SUSPENDED CADENCE. No row is a search. No row carries the Wingtech or Yuching designators. ARB/24/16 and ARB/24/45 are absent. Nothing in this file asserts anything about ICSID Convention Article 52 or the grounds it enumerates.

urls.purpose: ROW 1 - PAGE-TYPE CONTROL and construction certification for the designator the NDP register rendered. Expected HIT. A 200 plus this TRUE establishes that a case designator read out of a register's visible prose, percent-encoded into the CaseNo query parameter, resolves to a case-detail page whose tag-stripped prose the relay can search. It does NOT establish that the page is the ARB/24/19 docket: the designator sits in the request URL and a decoded echo would be indistinguishable. Row 2 is the row that discriminates. A non-200 here takes rows 1 and 2 out of the question entirely and is an observation about the constructed path, never about the resource.

ROW 2 - THE ECHO-PROOF DISCRIMINATOR for row 1, companion control row 1, same URL, same run. The literal is attested at exactly 1 occurrence in this council's own reduction of the NDP register, blob 21d09011365725d30bad92657bb439a4bf28f961 records[5] and records[6], inside the span 'Company v. Republic of Croatia - (ICSID Case No. ARB/24/19) Procedural Order No. 3 (English) July 2, 2026'. It is in no request URL, so no echo can produce it. ITS WEAKNESS IS NAMED: a respondent State is not a rigid designator for a case - many matters name the Republic of Croatia - so a TRUE carries only in CONJUNCTION with the constructed designator in the URL, and the claimant name is unavailable to me because the register window is truncated on the left at 'imited Company'. A FALSE with row 1 TRUE is fully interpretable and is the more informative outcome: it would mean the constructed URL resolves to a case-detail page that is not this matter's, which closes hop 2 of the chain at once. FOUNDS NOTHING about the Croatia matter.

ROW 3 - PAGE-TYPE CONTROL and construction certification for the designator the DISQUALIFICATION register rendered. Expected HIT. Three designators from three different registers are fired rather than one because the governing prior art is that a construction rule validated on few observations fails on the next - the analogy rule held at four label lengths and failed at two, six observations, and will not survive a seventh register. Same echo qualification as row 1.

ROW 4 - THE ECHO-PROOF DISCRIMINATOR for row 3, companion control row 3, same URL, same run. A CLAIMANT NAME and therefore a stronger rigid designator than row 2's respondent State. Attested at exactly 1 occurrence in blob 21d09011365725d30bad92657bb439a4bf28f961 records[7], inside the span 'Neltume Ports S.A. v. Oriental Republic of Uruguay (ICSID Case No. ARB/24/14) Spanish July 29, 2026'. In no request URL. FOUNDS NOTHING about the Uruguay matter, nothing about disqualification as an instrument, and nothing about thread 11, whose four gates do not include it.

ROW 5 - PAGE-TYPE CONTROL and construction certification for the designator the PROVISIONAL MEASURES register rendered, and the third of three. It carries one extra interest: ARB/25/9 is the shortest designator of the three and the only one with a single-digit sequence number, so if percent-encoding is not the whole of the construction this is the row most likely to show it. Same echo qualification as row 1.

ROW 6 - THE ECHO-PROOF DISCRIMINATOR for row 5, companion control row 5, same URL, same run. A claimant name, attested at exactly 1 occurrence in blob 21d09011365725d30bad92657bb439a4bf28f961 records[9], inside the span 'Orano Mining SAS v. Republic of Niger (ICSID Case No. ARB/25/9) ORDONNANCE DE PROCEDURE No. 2 June 30, 2026'. 'Orano' is used in deliberate preference to the document designation in that same span, which carries U+00C9 in 'PROCEDURE' as rendered and would be a known false-negative risk the record could not see. In no request URL. FOUNDS NOTHING about the Niger matter and nothing about provisional measures as an instrument.
